## Outcome

Describe the user/system behavior and implementation-plan task ID.

## Owner and dependencies

Name the lead, consuming owner and prerequisite contract/table/endpoint.

## Acceptance

Define observable success and required failure/conflict cases. Include security and data consistency requirements where applicable.

## Handoff

List examples, tests, docs, generated artifacts and migrations needed by the next owner.
